Polar Jolt.name: Polar Jolt
Polar Jolt.description: The user touches a target's arm or shoulder and sends a measured electric jolt through them that also leaves a brief magnetic pull on any steel they wear or carry. It deals minor electric damage, forces them to drop a held item, and pulls their metal sleeves, buckles or cuffs together so they cannot run or swing until the end of their next turn; rubber or thick insulation blocks it. Strain: light.
